## Code Review Checklist
- [ ] Code follows style guidelines (Ruff/Black)
- [ ] Tests added and validated successfully
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/Changelog)
- [ ] Structured logging integrated
- [ ] Robust exception handling implemented
- [ ] No hardcoded configuration constants
- [ ] Type hints and docstrings included on all new methods
